label: GO near episode end after an unrewarded trial, with a strong a1 choice
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), only after an unrewarded previous trial (in_rew=0 at D1; prev_reward=1 accounts for <0.1% of mass), and almost only in the last ~12 trials of the episode (96% of mass in trials 90-99, none before trial 80). Low value-head output reflects that the episode is nearly over (98% of mass in the lowest value bin), and the policy strongly favours a1 (99% of activations have model_act=a1, 74% of mass has choice logit > 8). It does not fire at D1 or D2, after rewarded trials, early in the episode, or when the agent leans a2. The highest-lift context is a previous trial that was a rare transition (prev_common=0, 80% of mass; typically a1 -> S2 rare, unrewarded), with S1 good and the agent staying on a1, which is the model-based response. I did not score this as part of the predicate because adding prev_action/prev_common lowered recall. Every variable in the predicate is observed or is the model's own output (value, choice logit), so no future variable is used. Dev: P 0.70, R 0.85, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.94. Most false positives are late-episode unrewarded GO steps with a strong a1 preference where the feature stays silent, so the gating is not fully captured.
